reviews.x: My old salon-bought products snapped my last nerve.  After binge buying over a dozen different products to replace the stuff I had been buying from my stylist for the past year, I am happy to say I found 2 excellent products.  Shiner Gold is quite outstanding, with a medium-strong hold, a nice subtle, rich scent, and wonderful consistency. This product was suggested to me from my review of [[ASIN:B00BFJGM5M Suavecito Pomade Original Hold 3-Pack]], where another customer talked about the hold.  This Shiner Gold does indeed have superior hold to most anything else I've used.  Your hair will stay in place all day long and then some.  But what really impressed me is that it also seems to tame and soften your hair at the same time.  I'm leaving this review 30 hours after applying the product and my hair still looks excellent. reviews.t: Great choice! Great smell, Great shine, Great hold.
reviews.x: I love my Shiner.  It's got a good smell....what is it pina-colota?  Whatever it is, it's like a tropical coconut citrus smell.  The water soluble formula is right up there with the rest of them. Don't waste your time with those wax or petroleum based pomades.  I've heard some people gripe about the fact that the water based pomades "aren't natural" and can "damage your hair/scalp".  I've never experienced any of that from Shiner Gold or any of the others. It doesn't look pasty and gluey, it provides a natural look while still giving a great amount of hold. Better yet, if you find you need to readjust or fix anything halfway through the day, wetting your fingers makes the stuff just pliable enough to effectively fix whatever needs fixing, and not have to worry about your adjustment falling apart on you 10 minutes later. Ive used 3 quarter size amounts . as I go about my day and check on my hair I see that it has popped up in a few places from the desired "slick back" look. reviews.t: This is an amazing product. It comes in a silver tin and ...
reviews.x: This is an amazing product. It comes in a silver tin and within the tin is a lightly golden gel with a fruity fragrance to it. I wouldn't really call it a heavy hold but rather, more like a medium-heavy hold gel. I've been using this product for only a couple months now but, it does the job. Some people may end up using more than others. It is important to note that this product works best on dry hair so, if you are not getting the hold that you like, it may be due to the wetness of your hair.

PROS coconut smell, does die through out your day (after a wash the smell is there but very lightly usually most pomades do this) medium shine cheap for 4oz most higher quality pomades cost around $20+ a water based pomade so it washes easily leaves hair smooth easy to readjust best used when lightly damp not too much CONS falls apart somewhat quick, Unless you use a moderate amount. The more you use the longer it'll stay keep a comb with you, my hair length is about 7 inches and it tends fall a

reviews.t: The best pomade for my hair
reviews.x: This is the best pomade for my hair. I am the owner of a very thick and wavy head of latino hair, and I have tried the many brands for the past 10+ years (like Suavecito, Suavecito extra hold, Murray's, Crew, Brylcreem, etc). Shiner Gold's holds up. Keeps my hair straight and slicked back the entire day (unless it's summer, then I will loose the hold to the heat).  Also, it's not petroleum based so it washes out easily every night. Love this product. The best!

reviews.t: Great for a pomp or comb over
reviews.x: I have some serious cowlicks and unruly fine hair... this stuff let's me comb it any way that I want. Great product, lasts all day, lasts wearing a hat, lasts jumping in the ocean, lasts getting hammered and sleeping on a couch. Smell is acquired, not the best I've used, kind of waxy. But that's never been a make or break for me.

This stuff is great and at a fraction of the cost other products run for a hold that isn't as good. Easy to work through hair and style, wish solid hold, but washes out easily and doesn't leave a nasty residue. Will definitely continue to buy.

This is my favorite hair product! It's a water-based pomade; easy to apply and style quickly. My hair is short around the sides and longer at the top, so I use a dime sized amount. Hair feels soft. Easy to wash off. Highly recommended!

I've gone through a ton of hair products recently and I finally found the one for me. It smells great, isn't as greasy as other pomades, and I don't have to use a lot. Also, I can throw water in my hair and restyle. Amazing stuff!
One of the best water Pomades on the market. Super easy to go through the 4 oz. though. I hope they bring some bulk deals to amazon because it is a nice product.
Great pomade that smells great too. 4 stars because of price and I thought it takes too much to get the hold I want so the tin doesn't last too long.

reviews.t: This is a fantastic water soluable pomade that washes out well with just ...
reviews.x: This is a fantastic water soluable pomade that washes out well with just shampoo & water.  The hold is excellent.  Restyling is a piece of cake - if your hair is dry just run a comb through it and restyle as desired.  If you like the wet look, put this stuff in while your hair is still wet.  Restyling is simple as well - just re-wet and restyle.  It's that simple.  The stuff goes in very smooth and even. I've tried a bunch of other water based pomaded including Lay-Rite. reviews.t: Washes easily and is not greasy but not "crunchy" either
reviews.x: Always consistent strong hold for a slicked back look with a bit of shine; Holds stronger than the Shiner Gold in my opinion; I wear my hair short on the sides (Military) and this will last me 6mo; the hold and style stay put even after an entire day of putting on and taking off my cover (Uniform hat). Washes easily and is not greasy but not "crunchy" either.

Hubby uses this exclusively and had been getting it from his barber. They closed down due to covid so we had to buy from Amazon. Got her quickly but wasn't package securely enough and the can was dented upon arrival. Product was untouched and works the same as the other tins. Smells AMAZING and the only thing that holds his hair through 12 hour shifts.

reviews.t: Medium to high hold. High shine. Good stuff.
reviews.x: I liked this pomade. I tried it and the Psycho Hold in the same week. This one has a high shine and a medium to high hold. I liked it. It smelled a lot sweeter than I prefer but the smell doesn't linger so it's not a big problem. I do prefer Psycho Hold to this because I prefer a medium or matte shine to my hair.

Solid pomade. Good, somewhat floral scent. Great hold and doesn’t sweat out too much over the course of a day. One thing Inshoild mention: make sure your hair is somewhat damp or dry when you apply the pomade. I can never get it to hold with wet hair unless I use hairspray. Everyone’s different though.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the strong, long-lasting hold that keeps hair in place all day.
Many reviewers highlight the pleasant tropical coconut/pineapple scent.
Reviewers appreciate that it washes out easily and isn't greasy or slimy.
Several reviewers consider it excellent value for the money compared to pricier alternatives.
A few reviewers note the hold is weaker than expected or requires using more product.
